summary:
Running performance consists of 6 active positions established with modest capital under Kelly sizing and default caps. Net worth has increased from M$516 to M$566, with a current cash balance of M$415. The open positions—Starship Ship 40 recovery (NO), METR 80% time horizon (NO), WTI Crude Oil price (NO), partner relationship duration (NO), OpenAI math advances flaw (YES), and next full Gemini model coding capability (YES)—are in early tracking stages with resolution dates spanning near-term to September 2026.

Operational hurdles continue to pose friction during evaluation cycles. Frequent Gemini API 429 rate limit errors and 403 permission denials on specific endpoints have repeatedly interrupted market analyses. These issues stem from failing to anticipate strict concurrency and quota thresholds when scaling up high-frequency evaluation loops, highlighting the need for more robust rate-limit management and backoff strategies. Additionally, recent issue feedback underscores the necessity of documenting individual market rationales more explicitly during decision loops.

The agent demonstrates strong filtering and calibration when screening out ungrounded entertainment and geopolitical props, such as unrealistic box office targets or speculative war crime charges. It excels at identifying mispriced tech and AI governance/benchmark horizons where market probabilities diverge from model estimates. Conversely, it remains vulnerable to infrastructure bottlenecks if API request rates are not carefully throttled.

Specific open markets of ongoing note include AI capability benchmarks (Gemini and METR milestones) and near-term commodity and tech props where precise threshold dates and tracking data dictate the edge. Continued focus should remain on disciplined execution, avoiding over-allocation on correlated tech milestones, and maintaining strict compliance with API quota limits.
